facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post 'Life in Adtech: Supporting company growth through optimization' was published on 2023-08-29.
The post features Amitesh Mishra, who holds the title Team Lead, Business Analysis at StackAdapt.
facts.quote: This month features Amitesh Mishra, Team Lead, Business Analysis at StackAdapt.

facts.fact: Before joining StackAdapt, Amitesh Mishra worked in management consulting, refining processes and strategies for Fortune 100 companies.
facts.quote: In that role, I had several opportunities to make a meaningful impact on various industries by refining existing processes and strategies for prestigious Fortune 100 companies.
